sections.content: Use *alguna* *vez* in questions to ask whether an experience has happened at any time up to now. It normally appears after the auxiliary or near the end of the question. The answer can be positive or negative.

items.english: Have you ever visited the beach?

items.spanish: ¿Has estado alguna vez en la costa?
items.english: Have you ever been on the coast?
Yes, I have visited the beach.

items.spanish: No, no he visitado la playa.
items.english: No, I have not visited the beach.

sections.content: *alguna* *vez* is flexible about where it lands in the question — right after the auxiliary, ¿Has *alguna* *vez* visitado...?, or nearer the end, ¿Has *visitado* *alguna* *vez*...? — both orders sound natural, so don't worry about pinning it to one spot.
